facts.activity_file: replacing seals and seal support fluid
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: fire on TK-7102 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7102 and LT-7102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 20 March 2026 an incident occurred on TK-7102 and LT-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
